note: Lever 4a. As lever 2 at temperature 0.3 (the bridge forces 0).

items.text: 黛玉冷笑道：「我就知道，別人不挑剩下的也不給我。」
items.answer: Daiyu sneered, "I knew it. If others don't pick up the leftovers, they won't give them to me."

errors.evidence: If others don't pick up the leftovers, they won't give them to me.
errors.why: The double-negation structure is misread; the meaning is that she gets only what others have picked over and left, not that others must first pick up leftovers.

items.text: 鳳姐道：「我成日家說你太軟弱了，縱的家裡人這樣還了得了。」
items.answer: "Every day I tell you that you are too weak; how can one endure such behavior from the household members if you let it go on?"

errors.evidence: the household members
errors.why: 家裡人 here means household servants/retainers (Jiao Da), not family members, though the 'behavior' context limits the damage.

errors.evidence: how can one endure such behavior from the household members if you let it go on?
errors.why: The rhetorical 還了得了 is rendered stiffly and the sentence is awkward, and the 'indulge' sense of 縱 is only implied.

items.text: 寶玉未及回言，只見舡頭上來了兩人，一僧一道，夾住寶玉說道：「俗緣已畢，還不快走。」
items.answer: Before Baoyu could reply, two figures appeared at the bow of the boat—one a monk, the other a Taoist priest. They stepped forward and flanked him, saying: "Your mortal ties are now complete; why do you not leave quickly?"

items.text: 平兒笑道：「『得饒人處且饒人』，得省的將就些事也罷了。
items.answer: Ping'er smiled and said, "Where it is possible to let people off, one should spare them; where a little compromise can be made, that will do."

errors.evidence: where a little compromise can be made, that will do
errors.why: The source says to save trouble and let matters pass (得省的將就些事); "compromise" drops the "saving trouble" sense and is slightly off.

items.text: 黛玉道：「不曾讀，只上了一年學，些須認得幾個字。」
items.answer: "I have studied nothing, having attended school for only one year and learned just a few characters."

errors.evidence: "I have studied nothing, having attended...
errors.why: The speaker attribution 黛玉道 (Daiyu said) is dropped.

errors.evidence: I have studied nothing
errors.why: 不曾讀 means she hasn't studied the books; "nothing" overstates it and sits oddly with a year of school.

items.text: 因此劉姥姥看不過，乃勸道：「姑爺，你別嗔著我多嘴。
items.answer: That was why Old Lady Liu could not bear to see him and so advised him, saying, "Young master, do not be angry with me for speaking out of turn.

errors.evidence: Young master
errors.why: 姑爺 means son-in-law (Granny Liu addressing her daughter's husband); 'Young master' misses the family relationship, though the address and speaker are still clear.

items.text: 李貴笑道：“不怕你老人家惱我，素日你老人家到底有些不正經，所以這些兄弟才不聽。
items.answer: Li Gui smiled and said, "Brother, don't be angry with me. You've always been a bit of a loose cannon, which is why these brothers won't listen to you."

errors.evidence: You've always been a bit of a loose cannon
errors.why: "不正經" means improper or undignified conduct, not a reckless, unpredictable "loose cannon", so the criticism is misdirected.

errors.evidence: Brother, don't be angry with me.
errors.why: Li Gui is a servant and addresses Jia Rui as 你老人家, a respectful "sir"; "Brother" is wrong, and the polite preface "不怕…惱我" ("forgive my frankness") is flattened.

errors.evidence: these brothers won't listen to you
errors.why: "兄弟" means the young schoolmates, and a literal "brothers" could mislead the reader.

items.text: 作者自云：因曾歷過一番夢幻之後，故將真事隱去，而借通靈之說，撰此《石頭記》一書也。
items.answer: The author says: "Having once experienced a dream and an illusion, I have therefore hidden the true events and, by means of the tale of the Spirit Stone, composed this book called The Story of the Stone."

errors.evidence: Having once experienced a dream and an illusion, I have therefore hidden
errors.why: The source says 作者自云 in the third person, but the candidate switches to a first-person quotation. "A dream and an illusion" also renders 夢幻 less naturally than a single dream-like illusion.

errors.evidence: the tale of the Spirit Stone
errors.why: 通靈 is rendered as "Spirit Stone", which loosely names the spiritually aware jade; the nuance of communicating with spirit is partly lost, though the meaning is largely intact.

items.text: 孫悟空在傍聞講，喜得他抓耳撓腮，眉花眼笑，忍不住手之舞之，足之蹈之。
items.answer: Sun Wukong listened to the lecture from the side, so delighted that he tweaked his ears and scratched his cheeks, his brows bloomed with joy and his eyes danced with mirth; he could not help but dance with his hands and stamp with his feet.

items.text: 有一般天罡數，該三十六般變化；有一般地煞數，該七十二般變化。
items.answer: There is the Celestial Star number, which entails thirty-six transformations; there is the Earthly Fiend number, which entails seventy-two transformations.

items.text: 悟空道：「我自聞道之後，有七十二般地煞變化之功，觔斗雲有莫大的神通；善能隱身遯身，起法攝法。
items.answer: Wukong said, "Since I first heard the Way, I have mastered the seventy-two transformations of earth and hell, and my somersault cloud possesses immense power; I am skilled in hiding my body, vanishing from sight, and casting spells.

errors.evidence: seventy-two transformations of earth and hell
errors.why: 地煞 is the Disha set of transformations, not 'earth and hell'; this invents a hell sense.

errors.evidence: casting spells.
errors.why: 起法攝法 (raising and drawing in magic) is reduced to 'casting spells', losing the paired action; 隱身遯身 is also somewhat blurred.

errors.evidence: Since I first heard the Way
errors.why: 'Heard the Way' is a literal rendering; 聞道 means learning the Dao, and 'first' is added.

items.text: 卻說他師徒兩個策馬前來，直至山門首觀看，果然是一座寺院。
items.answer: Now, he and his disciple rode their horses forward until they reached the mountain gate and looked on; indeed, it was a temple.

errors.evidence: he and his disciple rode their horses forward
errors.why: 他師徒兩個 means 'master and disciple, the two of them'; the candidate makes 'he' someone else's companion, which misidentifies the referent (one master, one disciple, with no separate 'he').

errors.evidence: until they reached the mountain gate
errors.why: 山門 is the temple's main gate; 'mountain gate' without clarification may mislead, though the following 'temple' softens it.

items.text: 卻說那個妖王在洞裡歡喜道：「小的們，孫行者吃了虧去了。
items.answer: Now that demon king, inside his cave, laughed with delight: "My little ones, Sun Wukong has taken a beating and gone."

errors.evidence: Sun Wukong has taken a beating and gone
errors.why: 吃了虧 means he got the worst of it or suffered a setback, not literally 'a beating'; this slightly overstates what happened.

items.text: 卻說三藏自貞觀十三年九月望前三日，蒙唐王與多官送出長安關外。
items.answer: Now, it was three days before the full moon in the ninth year of Zhenguan, Thirteenth Year of Emperor Taizong's reign, that Tripitaka had been escorted beyond the Chang'an Pass by King Tang and his officials.

errors.evidence: in the ninth year of Zhenguan, Thirteenth Year of Emperor Taizong's reign
errors.why: The source says the ninth month of Zhenguan year 13. The candidate turns 'ninth month' into 'ninth year' and then adds a confusing 'Thirteenth Year', so the date is garbled.

errors.evidence: Thirteenth Year of Emperor Taizong's reign
errors.why: The source does not mention Emperor Taizong. The candidate adds him as an explanatory gloss.

errors.evidence: many officials
errors.why: The candidate says 'his officials', which loses the sense of 'many officials' escorting him together with the king.

items.text: 孔明囑付曰：「吾受劉皇叔三顧之恩，不容不出。
items.answer: Zhuge Liang instructed, "I have received the kindness of Liu the Prince's Three Visits and cannot refuse to leave.

errors.evidence: Liu the Prince's Three Visits
errors.why: "Liu the Prince" is an awkward, inaccurate rendering of the title 劉皇叔 (Imperial Uncle Liu), and capitalizing "Three Visits" reads oddly.

items.text: 玄德曰：「備乃中山靖王之後；自涿郡剿戮黃巾，大小三十餘戰，頗有微功，因得除今職。」
items.answer: Xuande said, "I am a descendant of the Prince of Zhongshan Jing; since I began slaughtering the Yellow Turbans in Zhuo, I have fought over thirty battles of varying sizes and achieved some minor merit, thus earning my current post."

errors.evidence: the Prince of Zhongshan Jing
errors.why: The title order is awkward; 'Prince Jing of Zhongshan' is the natural form.

errors.evidence: in Zhuo,
errors.why: 'Zhuo Commandery' is the place name; 'Zhuo' alone is imprecise, though understandable.

items.text: 玄德曰：「我與民秋毫無犯，那得財物與他？」
items.answer: Xuande said, "I have not committed the slightest offense against the people; how could I have any wealth to give him?"

items.text: 馬謖在山上見之，大笑曰：「彼若有命，不來圍山。」
items.answer: Ma Su, seeing this from the mountain, laughed aloud: "If he has any life left in him, he will not come to besiege the mountain."

items.text: 張飛性起，向玄德換了坐下馬，搶出陣來，叫曰：「我捉你不得，誓不上關！」
items.answer: Zhang Fei, his temper flaring, swapped mounts with Xuande and charged out of the formation, shouting, "If I cannot catch you, I swear I will not retreat to the pass!"

items.text: 行到赤岸坡，見蜀兵已去遠，乃引還，顧謂眾將曰：「孔明已死，我等皆高枕無憂矣！」
items.error: The operation was aborted due to timeout

errors.why: The operation was aborted due to timeout

items.text: 武松道：「只好恁地，卻又來望哥哥。」
items.answer: "Such is enough for now; I shall come to visit my brother later."

items.text: 智深尋思道：「這個大寺，如何敗落的恁地？」
items.answer: Zhishen pondered, "How has this great temple fallen into such ruin?"

items.text: 魯達道：「恁地時，洒家自去便了。」
items.answer: Lu Da said, "If that's the case, I'll just go on my own."

items.text: 宋江道：「兄弟，卻是你殺了小衙內，雖是軍師嚴令，論齒序他也是你哥哥，且看我面，與他伏個禮，我卻自拜你便了。」
items.answer: Brother, it was you who killed the young master. Although the strategist issued a strict order, by age he is your elder brother; show him respect before me, and I will bow to you myself.

errors.evidence: show him respect before me
errors.why: 且看我面 means 'for my sake' and 伏個禮 means to make a bow of apology; 'show him respect before me' is vague and suggests doing it in front of Song Jiang.

errors.evidence: I will bow to you myself.
errors.why: The settling force of 便了 ('that will settle it') is not conveyed.

items.text: 酒家道：「客官，你須見我門前招旗上面明明寫道：『三碗不過岡』。」
items.answer: "The guest, you must see the banner above my door clearly written: 'Three bowls and one cannot pass the ridge.'"

errors.evidence: you must see the banner above my door clearly written
errors.why: 須見 means "surely you must have seen", a mild reproach; "must see" reads as an order and misses the past-tense sense.

errors.evidence: "The guest, you must see the banner
errors.why: "The guest," is an awkward address for 客官, and the speaker (the tavern keeper) is not identified.

items.text: 戴宗連忙回轉身來問道：「壯士素不曾拜識，如何呼喚賤名？」
items.answer: Dai Zong quickly turned back and asked, "I have never had the honor of meeting you before. What is your name?"

errors.evidence: What is your name?
errors.why: Dai Zong asks why the stranger calls out his humble name; the candidate turns this into a question about the stranger's name, which Dai Zong asks only later.

errors.evidence: I have never had the honor of meeting you before.
errors.why: The address 壯士 is dropped, and so is the self-deprecating 賤名 ("my humble name") along with the act of calling it out.

items.text: 見我管待客人在此喫酒，你便與他三五升米便了，何須直來問我！」
items.answer: "See that I am treating guests with wine here; just give him three or five sheng of rice, why must he come straight to ask me!"

errors.evidence: why must he come straight to ask me!
errors.why: The one who came to ask is the retainer being scolded (you), not the priest (he).

errors.evidence: See that I am treating guests with wine here
errors.why: "See that" reads as an imperative; the source means "since you see I'm entertaining guests".

items.text: 鲁镇的酒店的格局，是和别处不同的：都是当街一个曲尺形的大柜台，柜里面豫备着热水，可以随时温酒。
items.answer: The layout of the wine shops in Lu Town differs from elsewhere: each features a large counter shaped like a carpenter's square right on the street, with hot water kept inside to warm up wine at any time.

errors.evidence: a large counter shaped like a carpenter's square right on the street
errors.why: "当街" means the counter faces the street, which "right on the street" blurs, though a reader would still understand roughly.

items.text: 到了年关，掌柜取下粉板说：『孔乙己还欠十九个钱呢！』
items.answer: When the New Year approached, the shopkeeper took down the blackboard and said, "Kong Yiji still owes nineteen qian!"

errors.evidence: When the New Year approached
errors.why: This loses the sense of 年关 as the year-end debt-settling time, though the timing is roughly right.

errors.evidence: took down the blackboard
errors.why: 粉板 is a lime/chalk board for recording debts; 'blackboard' is slightly inaccurate but conveys a similar object.

errors.evidence: nineteen qian
errors.why: The untranslated unit 'qian' is unexplained for an English reader; 'coins' or 'cash' would be clearer.

items.text: 孔乙己便涨红了脸，额上的青筋条条绽出，争辩道：『窃书不能算偸……窃书！……读书人的事，能算偸么？』
items.answer: Kong Yiji flushed red, the veins on his forehead bulging as he argued, "Stealing books doesn't count as stealing... Stealing! ... What a scholar does can't be called stealing!"

errors.evidence: "Stealing books doesn't count as stealing... Stealing! ..."
errors.why: Both 窃 and 偸 are rendered as "stealing", so the contrast between the refined word 窃 and the plain 偸, which is the whole point of his argument, is lost and the statement reads as self-contradictory.

errors.evidence: the veins on his forehead bulging
errors.why: Drops "blue" (青筋) and "one by one" (条条).

errors.evidence: What a scholar does can't be called stealing!
errors.why: The rhetorical question 能算偸么 becomes a flat statement, which weakens the indignant tone.

items.text: 又好笑，又不耐烦，懒懒的答他道：『谁要你教，不是草头底下一个来回的回字么？』
items.answer: "Who needs your teaching? Isn't the character for 'hui' simply the one with a grass radical on top and a 'return' underneath?"

errors.evidence: "Who needs your teaching?
errors.why: The narrator's simultaneous amusement and impatience and his listless manner of answering (又好笑，又不耐烦，懒懒的答他道) are entirely missing.

items.text: 我的父亲允许了；我也很高兴，因为我早听到闰土这名字，而且知道他和我仿佛年纪，闰月生的，五行缺土，所以他的父亲叫他闰土。
items.answer: My father gave his consent; I was also very happy, for I had long heard the name Runtu and knew that he was of an age similar to mine, born in a leap month, lacking earth among the five elements, so his father named him Runtu.

items.text: 现在我所谓希望，不也是我自己手制的偶像么？
items.answer: Is not the hope I speak of now also an idol made by my own hands?

items.text: 我看出他话中全是毒，笑中全是刀，他们的牙齿，全是白厉厉的排着，这就是吃人的家伙。
items.answer: I saw that his words were all poison, his laughter was all knives, and their teeth were arranged in a menacingly white row—these are the creatures who devour people.

errors.evidence: arranged in a menacingly white row
errors.why: This loses the 'sharp/fierce' sense of 白厉厉 and its 'all lined up' force; it is a minor loss, since 'menacingly white' hints at it.

items.text: 我也不怕；虽然不吃人，胆子却比他们还壮。
items.answer: I am not afraid; even though I do not eat people, my courage is greater than theirs.

errors.evidence: I am not afraid;
errors.why: The 也 ('also/for my part') is dropped, losing a slight link to his earlier calm.

errors.evidence: even though I do not eat people, my courage is greater than theirs
errors.why: 'Even though' and the plain comparative miss the concessive 虽然...却 and the intensifying 还 ('even bolder'); 'although ... even bolder' is more natural.

items.text: 子曰：「學而時習之，不亦說乎？有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎？人不知而不慍，不亦君子乎？」
items.answer: The Master said: "To learn and to repeat it at proper times, is there not joy in that? When friends come from afar, is there not delight in that? When others do not understand us yet we are not angry, is there not nobility in that?"

errors.evidence: is there not nobility in that?
errors.why: 君子 is 'gentleman/exemplary person', and 'nobility' loses the sense of a man of moral cultivation, and it drops the 'is this not the mark of a gentleman' framing.

errors.evidence: When others do not understand us yet we are not angry
errors.why: 人不知 means others do not recognize or know him (his worth); 'understand' is slightly off, though close enough to keep the meaning.

errors.evidence: To learn and to repeat it at proper times
errors.why: 習 means practice or review, and 'repeat' narrows it a little.

items.text: 子曰：「巧言令色，鮮矣仁。」
items.answer: The Master said: "He who is glib in his speech and wears an ingratiating expression has little of benevolence."

items.text: 子曰：「君子食無求飽，居無求安，敏於事而愼於言，就有道而正焉：可謂好學也已。」
items.answer: The Master said: "A superior man does not seek satiety in his food, nor comfort in his dwelling; he is diligent in his duties and cautious in his speech, and seeks out the virtuous to correct himself. This may be called true diligence in learning."

errors.evidence: This may be called true diligence in learning.
errors.why: 好學 means 'loving learning', not 'diligence in learning'; the nuance of fondness is lost, and the emphatic 也已 is only loosely conveyed by 'true'.

items.text: 子貢曰：「貧而無諂，富而無驕，何如？」子曰：「可也。未若貧而樂，富而好禮者也」。
items.answer: Zi Gong asked, "Is it good to be poor without being obsequious and rich without being arrogant?" The Master replied, "That is acceptable. But it is not as good as being poor yet happy and rich yet fond of ritual."

items.text:
牀前明月光，疑是地上霜。
舉頭望明月，低頭思故鄉。
items.answer:
Before my bed the bright moon's light shines,  
I suspect it is frost on the ground.  
I raise my head to gaze at the bright moon,  
I lower my head and think of my native land.

items.text:
紅豆生南國，春來發幾枝。
願君多采擷，此物最相思。
items.answer: Red beans grow in the southern land; how many branches bloom when spring comes? I wish you would gather them often, for this is the fruit of deepest longing.

errors.evidence: gather them often
errors.why: 多采擷 means pick plenty (a lot), not repeatedly or often.

errors.evidence: how many branches bloom
errors.why: 發 means sprout or put forth new shoots, not bloom; red beans are seeds and the line is about new growth.

errors.evidence: this is the fruit of deepest longing
errors.why: 此物最相思 means this thing most evokes longing; the rendering turns it into a metaphor about the fruit rather than the beans prompting thoughts of the absent.

items.text:
千山鳥飛絕，萬徑人蹤滅。
孤舟簑笠翁，獨釣寒江雪。
items.answer: In Qianshan, all birds have flown away; on every path, no human trace remains. A lone boat with an old man in a straw raincoat and hat stands alone, fishing in the cold river amidst the falling snow.

errors.evidence: In Qianshan, all birds have flown away
errors.why: 千山 ('a thousand mountains', i.e. all the mountains) is treated as a place name, 'Qianshan'.

errors.evidence: all birds have flown away
errors.why: 鳥飛絕 means no birds are flying any more; 'flown away' shifts the sense slightly.

errors.evidence: A lone boat with an old man ... stands alone, fishing
errors.why: The boat 'stands alone' and is joined to the man by 'with'; the man is the one who fishes alone. This blurs who does what.

errors.evidence: amidst the falling snow
errors.why: 'Falling' is not in the source; 雪 is only the snowy setting.
